newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - New Orleans, La..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - New Orleans, La..

text.p: SUMMARY OFFICIAL NOTICE OF BOND SALE

Sealed Proposals: The Board of Liquidation, City Debt (the Board''), will receive sealed proposals for the purchase of Thirty Million Dollars ($30,000,000) principal amount of City of New Orleans, Louisiana, Sewerage Service Revenue Bonds, Series 1997 (the Bonds').

Date of Sale: Wednesday, May 21, 1997 (or such other date as may be determined by the President and Secretary of the Board and advertised by Munifacts Disclosure Service). Hour of Sale: Ten o'clock (10:00) a.m., Central Daylight Time (Louisiana Time).
Place of Sale: Office of the Board of Liquidation, City Debt, Room 8E17, City Hall, 1300 Perdido Street, New Orleans, Louisiana 70112-2197.
Paying Agent, Authenticating Agent and Redemption Agent: The Chase Manhattan Bank, N.A., at its principal corporate trust office in New York, New York or any successor thereto (the Paying Agent'').
Security: The Bonds will be special and limited

obligations of the City of New Orleans, secured by and payable solely from a pledge of the revenues of the sewerage system of said City operated by the Sewerage and Water Board of New Orleans. The Bonds and the issue of which it forms a part do not constitute a general obligation of the City of New Orleans, and neither the credit nor the taxing power of the City of New Orleans is pledged to the payment thereof, or any part thereof, or to the payment of any interest thereon. Further details regarding the nature of the security for the Bonds and the pledge of the sewerage revenues to the payment of the Bonds may be found in the Official Statement.

Additional Information, Bid Forms, and Official Statements: Further information and particulars including the required bid form and an Official Statement relating to the Bonds will be furnished upon application to the undersigned.
Local (New Orleans) firms are encouraged to participate in groups submitting bids for the bonds, as members of the group or as senior underwriter.
